articles.summary: Docker Hub is slamming the brakes on free usage April 1st. These strict pull limits will silently break your CI if you’re not ready. You could build a registry mirror, audit 500 workflows, or... just switch to Blacksmith. Our runners come preconfigured with a pull-through cache that makes Docker pull limits a non-issue.
articles.title: You have 5 days before the new DockerHub limits f*ck you over
